facts.fact: 母亲葬礼前一天，Miri 把六片 Nurofen 与洒出的烹饪白兰地一起吞下，两种东西叠加造成感觉错序的“多普勒效应”
facts.anchor: I’d taken six Nurofen together with a spill of cooking brandy

facts.fact: Miri 把 Centre 的号码设进新手机的自动拨号，此后按一个键就能开始一天
facts.anchor: I programme the Centre into the handset’s automated dial function

facts.fact: Miri 撞见 Leah 往柠檬水里舀食盐，把杯子拿走
facts.anchor: caught her spooning table salt into the mixture

facts.fact: 争吵中 Leah 抓起橙子砸向砖墙，橙子像内脏一样发出湿软的声响滚过地板
facts.anchor: takes up the orange and throws it against the wall

facts.fact: Leah 少女时期在水族馆打工，十七岁，剪短头发、穿截到膝上的潜水服喂海豚
facts.anchor: Leah worked at the aquarium as a teenager

facts.fact: 十八岁的 Leah 曾在闭馆后放一个女友进水族馆，两人在 Open Ocean 缸边亲吻，事后去章鱼房发现 Pamela 已死
facts.anchor: letting a girlfriend into the aquarium one night after hours

facts.fact: Leah 三十岁生日时，Miri 送她一整版水族馆宣传明信片，最后第二张印着 Pamela
facts.anchor: on Leah’s thirtieth birthday, when I gave her a sleeve of promotional postcards

facts.fact: 某个夜里 Leah 尖叫，床被水浸透、水从她身上来，她抽搐着把一股水呕到床上，醒来不认识 Miri
facts.anchor: she vomits a shower of water across the bed

relations.kind: 伴侣／同住一间公寓但已分房，关系处在破裂边缘
relations.anchor: Say it was my choice to move into the spare room.
